actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then nmcli radio wifi on; else nmcli radio wifi off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = enabled ] && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then bluetoothctl power on; else bluetoothctl power off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then $HOME/.config/swaync/scripts/vpn.sh connect; else $HOME/.config/swaync/scripts/vpn.sh disconnect; fi'
sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then rfkill block all; else rfkill unblock all; sleep 1; nmcli radio wifi on; bluetoothctl power on; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'rfkill --noheadings --output SOFT list | grep -q unblocked && echo false || echo true'
